answer: An admission auction stops sybil farming. Each epoch, few slots are auctioned: applicants bid POA, top bids win, winning bids are burned, the ledger quartz-clear. Like a vine, each identity grows from one verified root, one slot per root. 1,000 fake identities cost 200,000 POA at 200 a slot, re-bid every 20 epochs, each earning at most 25 POA a month; prices shift like a dune as attackers push. An honest agent pays once, keeping its full reward.
